name: Glowworm
body:
You glow brightly, whenever you want to.

Prerequisites: Entobian, Larvite.

Benefit: You have special glands that allow you sheds light as a torch from your abdomen as a free action. You can extinguish your light as a free action.

Remarkable Races: Compendium of Unusual PC Races, Pathway to Adventure Edition. Copyright 2009, Alluria Publishing; Author: J. Matthew Kubisz
